items.question: How many business days does a refund to the original card take in the U.A.E.?
items.fact: UAE card refunds take 7 business days, depending on bank

items.question: Can a payment made with the in-app wallet balance be refunded to a card?
items.gold: No, wallet payments can't be refunded to a card.
items.fact: Wallet payments cannot be refunded to cards, only card payments
